## Scope and dependencies

and nonzero threshold cases, the controlled correlation and weak cosine-drive
energy statements, and sufficient joint limits for actual calibrated cells.
Its fixed inputs, normalization, graph domains, centering, finite resource
constants and exposed parent premises remain in force. The threshold hierarchy
includes the nonzero higher-order example; no universal positive leading term
or preservation of a degenerate threshold at every fixed spacing is asserted.

The supplied vacuum and massive carrier are premises. No physical selection,
fixed-amplitude infinite-time statement, Markov approximation, finite-heating
kinetic limit, axiom promotion or retained verdict follows from this assembly.

## Review chronology and correlation ordering

The root's separate 286-line probe was sealed at 07:26:04 UTC on 2026-10-13.
The fresh proof's plan was frozen at 07:31:50 UTC and its complete final proof
at 07:57:53 UTC. The fresh author had not read the root probe or the excluded
older partial at that proof freeze. Root then completely read the 792-line
proof and recorded ordinary conditional analytic acceptance at 08:10:23 UTC.
The root probe, seal and review were first exposed to this author afterwards,
solely for this later packaging task. Earlier source exclusions remain literal
historical records. The exact seals, corrections and read limits are archived.

The conventions must be distinguished. Here
`C(t)=omega(alpha_t(B)B)` has the negative spectral phase, while the root probe
uses `K(t)=omega(B alpha_t(B))=C(-t)` with the positive phase. The corresponding
tail phases are conjugate. The first-jet determinants have opposite signs and
the same squared modulus. This is a convention correspondence, not a core edit.

Shared root/fresh results have a separate source-excluded same-family
derivation. The fresh proof's added hierarchy, exact-threshold logarithm and
local-density arguments received root's later source-exposed analytic check.
No model-diverse, formal or retained independence is claimed. The more
restrictive root weak-amplitude window and the fresh sufficient window remain
distinguished in the preserved review; neither produces finite unscaled heating.
